title: Shapes
comment: Circles, rings, squares: where they are and how big; merge (all of them),
overlap (only where they all are), cut (one with another taken out); and
leave the numbers out, alea draws them, another composition every run. The
three runs at the end are this program's own draws.

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: shapes
sections.say: Circles, rings, squares. Merge them, cut them.
stage: let hk1 = text("03  ·  shapes", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: a circle: where, and how big
sections.label: a circle
sections.say: A circle: where it is, and how big.
stage: let d2 = a * inside * (T >= 10.3)
let circf = max(k2_code, max(f2 * RULE, d2 * INK))

sections.name: a ring, a square; merge
sections.label: merge
sections.say: A ring, a square turned twenty degrees. Merge: all of them.
stage: let mergf = max(k3_code, max(f3 * RULE, d3 * INK))

sections.name: overlap: only where they all are
sections.label: overlap
sections.say: Overlap: only where they all are.
stage: let d4 = max(overlap(a, c) * INK, merge(a, c) * RULE) * inside * (T >= 26.3)
let overf = max(k4_code, max(f4 * RULE, d4))

sections.name: cut: the circle, the ring taken out
sections.label: cut
sections.say: Cut: the circle, with the ring taken out.
stage: let d5 = cut(a, b) * inside * (T >= 32.8)
let cutf = max(k5_code, max(f5 * RULE, d5 * INK))

sections.name: chance: the numbers left out, drawn every run
sections.label: chance
sections.say: Leave the numbers out: alea draws them. Every run, another one.
stage: let chancef = max(k6_code, max(f6 * RULE, max(d6 * INK, g6 * GREY)))

sections.name: the end
sections.say: Next week: transforms. Move it, turn it, tile it, mirror it.
stage: let nsize = 0.2
let nadv = 0.5172 * nsize
let nx0e = 0.5 - 2.5 * nadv
let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.56, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 49.3)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.56) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 49.3)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  03  ·  shapes", x: 0.5, y: 0.70, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 49.8)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 50.3)
let e3 = text("next  ·  04  ·  transforms", x: 0.5, y: 0.94, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l7.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.02, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 51.5)
let endf = max(k7_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))
